title: FluidGen: Physics-Aware Fluid Video Generation via Motion-Guided Post-Training
title_zh: FluidGen：通过运动引导的后训练实现物理感知的流体视频生成

paragraphs.en: Video generation models produce visually compelling motion but systematically fail on fluid phenomena, including smoke, fire, and explosion debris, where outputs lack coherent vortical structure and collapse to bland dynamics that violate the physics of real fluids. Classical solvers achieve high physical fidelity but require detailed 3D scenes and carefully tuned parameters, making them impractical for in-the-wild imagery and video generation. We address this gap by injecting a data-driven fluid prior into a pre-trained video model, trained on a mixture of high-fidelity Houdini simulation data with paired velocity-field ground truth and curated in-the-wild fluid video data for appearance diversity. The core of our approach is a dual stream architecture that predicts per-frame velocity fields alongside RGB, supervised by simulation ground truth. This auxiliary signal regularizes generation toward physically consistent motion and exposes an interpretable physical quantity that we further leverage as a reward for velocity-aware direct preference optimization. Our model produces substantially more realistic fluid dynamics sequences than strong video baselines and optimization-based methods. Our data, code, and model will be publicly released. Project page: https://y-zheng18.github.io/FluidGen/ .

paragraphs.en: Realistic fluid phenomena, including billowing smoke, rolling fire, and the dust and ash of an explosion, are among the most important visual elements in film, games, and immersive media, and also among the hardest to make look right. Their motion is driven by complex, turbulent physical dynamics, and humans can notice errors in problematic fluid dynamics immediately: for example a plume that rises too uniformly, a flame that moves in an unnatural direction, or a debris cloud without proper swirling structure. Synthesizing fluid content that holds up under this realism has been a long-standing goal in computer graphics, and despite decades of progress, it still typically requires expert artists, expensive simulation tools, and large amounts of manual effort.
paragraphs.zh: 逼真的流体现象，包括翻腾的烟雾、翻滚的火焰，以及爆炸产生的尘土与灰烬，是电影、游戏和沉浸式媒体中最重要的视觉元素之一，同时也是最难做逼真的内容之一。 它们的运动由复杂而湍急的物理动力学驱动，人类能够立刻察觉有问题的流体动力学错误：例如上升得过于均匀的烟羽、朝不自然方向移动的火焰，或者缺乏合理漩涡结构的碎屑云。 合成能够经得起这种真实感考验的流体内容，长期以来一直是计算机图形学的一个目标，尽管经过数十年的进展，它通常仍然需要专家艺术家、昂贵的仿真工具以及大量的手工工作。

paragraphs.en: One family of approaches treats fluid dynamics synthesis as a simulation problem. Classical physical solvers solve the Navier–Stokes equations ( Constantin and Foiaş, 1988 ) on grids ( Stam, 2023 ; Bridson, 2015 ) , particles ( Müller et al., 2003 ; Zhu and Bridson, 2005 ) , or hybrid representations ( Macklin and Müller, 2013 ) , and produce physically faithful results when the scene parameters and boundary conditions are carefully defined. To extend simulation to single- or multi-view videos captured in the wild, more recent works reconstruct a 3D fluid representation from videos with regularization derived from physical priors ( Eckert et al., 2019 ; Chu et al., 2022 ; Yu et al., 2023 ; Gao et al., 2025 ) and re-simulating with the reconstructed representation. Another line of work uses neural networks as replacements to accelerate explicit solvers ( Kim et al., 2019 ; Sanchez-Gonzalez et al., 2020 ; Ummenhofer et al., 2019 ; Cai et al., 2021 ) . A shared fundamental component of these works is the reliance on manually designed simulation rules (e.g. , Navier–Stokes equations) that are themselves only approximations of the highly complex fluid dynamics process. As a result, they remain brittle: small reconstruction errors build up, fluid parameters must be tuned per scene, and the state-of-the-art methods still struggle on the casual images that dominate real-world content.
paragraphs.zh: 有一类方法将流体动力学合成视为仿真问题。 经典的物理求解器在网格（Stam, 2023；Bridson, 2015）、粒子（Müller et al., 2003；Zhu and Bridson, 2005）或混合表示（Macklin and Müller, 2013）上求解纳维–斯托克斯方程（Constantin and Foiaş, 1988），当场景参数和边界条件被仔细定义时，能够产生物理上忠实的结果。 为了将仿真扩展到野外采集的单视角或多视角视频，较新的工作从视频中重建三维流体表示，并利用源自物理先验的正则化（Eckert et al., 2019；Chu et al., 2022；Yu et al., 2023；Gao et al., 2025），再基于重建的表示进行重新仿真。 另一类工作使用神经网络作为替代来加速显式求解器（Kim et al., 2019；Sanchez-Gonzalez et al., 2020；Ummenhofer et al., 2019；Cai et al., 2021）。 这些工作的一个共同的基本组成部分是依赖人工设计的仿真规则（例如纳维–斯托克斯方程），而这些规则本身只是对高度复杂的流体动力学过程的近似。 因此，它们仍然脆弱：微小的重建误差会不断累积，流体参数必须针对每个场景进行调节，而且最先进的方法在真实世界内容中占主导的随意拍摄图像上仍然表现不佳。

paragraphs.en: A new family of approaches turns to large-scale generative models, which now carry remarkably strong priors over both motion and appearance from internet-scale training ( Wan et al., 2025 ; Brooks et al., 2024 ; Polyak et al., 2024 ; Bar-Tal et al., 2024 ) . A natural way to use them in physical content creation is as a learned renderer on top of an explicit simulator, leaning on the generator’s appearance prior while leaving the dynamics to the solver. Yet on fluid phenomena specifically, this combination still falls short. On their own, modern video models consistently violate basic physical rules in scenes with complex fluid dynamics ( Motamed et al., 2025 ) . Earlier physics-aware generation efforts have focused mostly on rigid ( Liu et al., 2024 ) or elastic ( Tan et al., 2024 ) objects rather than on volumetric, turbulent fluids. To close this gap on fluid dynamics, very recent works ( Li et al., 2025b ; Zhan et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2026 ) explicitly couple a video generator with an underlying simulator that provides fluid dynamics guidance. However, all aforementioned pipelines still depend on the heavy machinery of an authored 3D scene and a configured simulator, which limits their applicability to in-the-wild fluid content synthesis.
paragraphs.zh: 一类新方法转向大规模生成模型，这类模型经过互联网规模的训练，在运动和外观方面都具备非常强的先验（Wan et al., 2025; Brooks et al., 2024; Polyak et al., 2024; Bar-Tal et al., 2024）。 在物理内容创作中利用这些模型的一种自然方式，是将其作为显式模拟器之上的可学习渲染器，即依靠生成器的外观先验，同时把动力学留给求解器处理。 然而具体到流体现象，这种组合仍然有所不足。 就其自身而言，现代视频模型在具有复杂流体动力学的场景中持续违反基本物理规则（Motamed et al., 2025）。 早期具备物理感知的生成工作大多聚焦于刚体（Liu et al., 2024）或弹性体（Tan et al., 2024）物体，而非体积性的湍流流体。 为了弥补流体动力学方面的这一差距，近期的一些工作（Li et al., 2025b; Zhan et al., 2026; Liu et al., 2026）显式地将视频生成器与提供流体动力学引导的底层模拟器耦合起来。 然而，上述所有流程仍然依赖于手工构建的 3D 场景和已配置模拟器这类重量级设施，这限制了它们在真实场景流体内容合成中的适用性。

paragraphs.en: We argue that video model itself can learn complex fluid dynamics directly, but RGB supervision alone provides an insufficient training signal: appearance errors dominate the convergence while subtle physical errors are easily ignored. We therefore introduce an internal motion representation, jointly predicted with RGB, that explicitly exposes fluid dynamics to the model. Specifically, we predict a 3D velocity field describing fluid motion over time, providing a more physically meaningful representation than optical flow or trajectories ( Wang et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2025b ) .
paragraphs.zh: 我们认为，视频模型本身可以直接学习复杂的流体动力学，但仅靠 RGB 监督提供的训练信号是不充分的：外观误差主导收敛过程，而细微的物理误差容易被忽略。 因此，我们引入一种内部运动表征，与 RGB 联合预测，将流体动力学显式地呈现给模型。 具体而言，我们预测一个随时间描述流体运动的三维速度场，相比光流或轨迹（Wang et al., 2024; Zhang et al., 2025b），它提供了更具物理意义的表征。

paragraphs.en: This representation enables a clean two-stage post-training pipeline for a pretrained video diffusion model ( Wan et al., 2025 ) . First, we jointly supervise RGB and velocity prediction using high-fidelity Houdini simulations with ground-truth velocity fields, together with in-the-wild fluid videos for appearance diversity and gives the model the generalization ability for in-the-wild content. Second, we perform velocity-aware DPO ( Rafailov et al., 2023 ; Liu et al., 2025a ) , using the model’s own predicted velocity field together with appearance signals to rank samples by physical plausibility. The resulting model produces more coherent vortices, natural advection, and fine-scale turbulent structure and clearly outperforms state-of-the-art strong video-generation and simulation-based baselines.
paragraphs.zh: 这种表示方法为预训练视频扩散模型（ Wan et al., 2025 ）提供了一个简洁的两阶段后训练流程。 首先，我们使用带有真实速度场的高保真 Houdini 仿真，并结合野外流体视频以保证外观多样性，对 RGB 预测和速度预测进行联合监督，从而赋予模型对野外内容的泛化能力。 其次，我们执行速度感知的 DPO（ Rafailov et al., 2023 ; Liu et al., 2025a ），利用模型自身预测的速度场结合外观信号，按物理合理性对样本进行排序。 所得到的模型能够生成更连贯的涡旋、自然的平流以及细尺度的湍流结构，并明显优于最先进的高性能视频生成基线和基于仿真的基线。

paragraphs.en: We propose a dual-head video model architecture that jointly predicts an internal fluid velocity field alongside RGB pixels, providing an explicit and interpretable physical signal that guides dynamics learning.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了一种双头视频模型架构，可同时预测内部流体速度场与 RGB 像素，从而提供一种显式且可解释的物理信号来引导动态学习。

paragraphs.en: We curate a fluid training corpus that pairs high-quality Houdini simulations with collected in-the-wild smoke, fire, and explosion footage, combining dense physical supervision with the appearance variety needed for real-world generalization.
paragraphs.zh: 我们构建了一个动态更新的训练语料库，将高质量的 Houdini 仿真与收集的真实场景烟雾、火焰和爆炸视频相结合，既提供稠密的物理监督，又具备真实世界泛化所需的外观多样性。

paragraphs.en: We design a two-stage training pipeline that first jointly supervises RGB and velocity prediction and then aligns the model outputs with a post-training stage using its own predicted velocity field as the reward.
paragraphs.zh: 我们设计了一个两阶段训练流程：首先对 RGB 预测和速度预测进行联合监督，然后在后训练阶段中使用模型自身预测的速度场作为奖励，将模型输出进行对齐。

paragraphs.en: Fluid Simulation and Reconstruction. Realistic fluid visual effect synthesis in graphics has long been driven by analytical physical simulation. Classical Eulerian solvers discretize the Navier–Stokes equations on regular grids ( Stam, 2023 ; Bridson, 2015 ) , while particle-based formulations ( Müller et al., 2003 ; Zhu and Bridson, 2005 ) represent fluids as collections of moving particles, and hybrid representations such as PBF ( Macklin and Müller, 2013 ) balance accuracy with interactivity from both sides. To reduce simulation cost, neural networks have been used as accelerating components for the traditional solvers ( Kim et al., 2019 ; Sanchez-Gonzalez et al., 2020 ; Ummenhofer et al., 2019 ; Cai et al., 2021 ) . Built on top of existing fluid simulation formulations, a complementary line of work aims to recover fluid representations directly from captured video and re-simulates them ( Eckert et al., 2019 ; Chu et al., 2022 ; Yu et al., 2023 ; Gao et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2025a ; Liu et al., 2025b ) . Combined with differentiable rendering, these works directly build fluid assets from real-world captures instead of requiring manual construction in the simulator. However all of these methods rely on human-defined simulation rules and are bounded by the approximation accuracy. Our work takes the opposite path: we treat fluid dynamics as the learnable property of a video model itself, without the explicit solver at inference time.
paragraphs.zh: 流体模拟与重建。 在图形学领域，逼真的流体视觉效果合成长期以来一直由解析式物理模拟驱动。 经典的欧拉求解器在规则网格上离散化纳维–斯托克斯方程（Stam, 2023; Bridson, 2015），而基于粒子的方法（Müller et al., 2003; Zhu and Bridson, 2005）将流体表示为运动粒子的集合，PBF 等混合表示（Macklin and Müller, 2013）则兼顾了双方的精度与交互性。 为了降低模拟成本，神经网络已被用作传统求解器的加速组件（Kim et al., 2019; Sanchez-Gonzalez et al., 2020; Ummenhofer et al., 2019; Cai et al., 2021）。 在现有流体模拟方法的基础上，另一条互补的研究路线旨在直接从拍摄的视频中恢复流体表示并对其进行重新模拟（Eckert et al., 2019; Chu et al., 2022; Yu et al., 2023; Gao et al., 2025; Li et al., 2025a; Liu et al., 2025b）。 结合可微渲染，这些工作能够直接从真实世界采集的数据构建流体资产，而无需在模拟器中手工构建。 然而所有这些方法都依赖于人工定义的模拟规则，并受限于其近似精度。 我们的工作选择了相反的路径：我们将流体动力学视为视频模型本身可学习的属性，在推理时无需显式求解器。

paragraphs.en: Physics-Aware Video Synthesis. Recent video diffusion models exhibit strong motion priors but are not necessarily physically faithful, and even frontier models still violate basic physical principles in scenes with complex dynamics ( Motamed et al., 2025 ; Bansal et al., 2025 ) . A line of work combines traditional simulation with video generation. PhysGen ( Liu et al., 2024 ) couples video generation with rigid-body physics through SDEdit ( Meng et al., 2021 ) , PhysMotion ( Tan et al., 2024 ) extends this into the elastic domain, and PhysDreamer ( Zhang et al., 2024 ) distills physical parameters using a video model as prior. These methods focus on solid materials and cannot naturally extend to volumetric, turbulent fluids. A second family ( Zhang et al., 2025a ) instead steers diffusion sampling with LLM-derived physical context. Another line of work fine-tunes video models on labeled synthetic data to emit auxiliary channels alongside RGB, though these channels are appearance properties, e.g. , intrinsics ( Zeng et al., 2024 ; Liang et al., 2025 ) or weather ( Lin et al., 2025 ) , rather than the dynamical state we predict.
paragraphs.zh: 物理感知的视频合成。 近期的视频扩散模型展现出强大的运动先验，但未必符合物理规律，即使最前沿的模型在具有复杂动力学的场景中仍会违反基本物理原理（Motamed et al., 2025；Bansal et al., 2025）。 一系列工作将传统仿真与视频生成相结合。 PhysGen（Liu et al., 2024）通过 SDEdit（Meng et al., 2021）将视频生成与刚体物理耦合，PhysMotion（Tan et al., 2024）将其扩展到弹性域，PhysDreamer（Zhang et al., 2024）则以视频模型作为先验来蒸馏物理参数。 这些方法聚焦于固体材料，无法自然地扩展到体积湍流流体。 另一类方法（Zhang et al., 2025a）则利用由大语言模型导出的物理上下文来引导扩散采样。 还有一类工作在带标注的合成数据上微调视频模型，使其在 RGB 之外输出辅助通道，但这些通道是外观属性，例如内参（Zeng et al., 2024；Liang et al., 2025）或天气（Lin et al., 2025），而非我们所预测的动力学状态。

paragraphs.en: Preference Optimization Post-Training. Preference optimization, as a post-training stage, has become a standard recipe for aligning generative models with human-defined high-dimensional quality. DPO ( Rafailov et al., 2023 ) provides a simple offline formulation for the optimization target, and Diffusion-DPO ( Wallace et al., 2024 ) further adapts it to training with diffusion models. VideoDPO ( Liu et al., 2025a ) extends preference alignment to the video diffusion domain with a multi-aspect scoring system, and DenseDPO ( Wu et al., 2026 ) introduces fine-grained temporal preference labels to better target motion quality. EpipolarDPO ( Kupyn et al., 2025 ) employs epipolar constraints to enhance geometry consistency of video generation. Inspired by these, we further treat physical quality, especially complex fluid effects, as another signal that can be used for preference optimization. In detail, we leverage our model’s native velocity field prediction as part of the reward signal, turning an auxiliary physical output into a physics-grounded preference indicator at the alignment stage.
paragraphs.zh: 偏好优化后训练。 偏好优化作为后训练阶段，已成为将生成模型与人类定义的高维质量对齐的标准方案。 DPO（Rafailov et al., 2023）为该优化目标提供了一种简单的离线形式化方法，而 Diffusion-DPO（Wallace et al., 2024）进一步将其适配到扩散模型的训练中。 VideoDPO（Liu et al., 2025a）通过多方面评分系统将偏好对齐扩展到视频扩散领域，DenseDPO（Wu et al., 2026）则引入细粒度的时间偏好标签，以更好地针对运动质量。 EpipolarDPO（Kupyn et al., 2025）利用对极约束来增强视频生成的几何一致性。 受这些工作启发，我们进一步将物理质量，尤其是复杂流体效果，视为另一种可用于偏好优化的信号。 具体而言，我们利用模型原生的速度场预测作为奖励信号的一部分，将一个辅助的物理输出转化为对齐阶段中基于物理的偏好指标。

Both stages share the same model and output velocity representation, which we introduce first in § 3.2 .

paragraphs.en: At every pixel of each generated frame, we represent the 3D motion of the underlying fluid particles as a velocity vector 𝐯 = ( v x , v y , v z ) ∈ ℝ 3 \mathbf{v}=(v_{x},v_{y},v_{z})\in\mathbb{R}^{3} , expressed in the camera coordinate system. paragraphs.en: First stage fine-tuning yields a model capable of jointly generating an RGB stream and a plausible velocity field stream in a single forward pass. However, the physical quality of generated samples still exhibits suboptimal performance. Many samples will remain visibly degenerate, as it is hard for the model to simply learn the physical process ( Bansal et al., 2025 ) – especially for highly unconstrained and complex fluid dynamics. Consequently, we employ a post-training stage to reduce this variability by aligning the generator with the physics-informed reward, through the preference optimization.
paragraphs.zh: 第一阶段微调得到一个能够在单次前向传播中同时生成 RGB 流和合理速度场流的模型。 然而，生成样本的物理质量仍表现欠佳。 许多样本仍然明显退化，因为模型很难仅靠学习来掌握物理过程（Bansal et al., 2025）——对于高度无约束且复杂的流体动力学而言尤其如此。 因此，我们采用后训练阶段，通过偏好优化将生成器与物理信息奖励对齐，从而降低这种变异性。

paragraphs.en: Implementation Details. Our model is initialized from the pretrained Wan-2.1-14B image-to-video diffusion model ( Wan et al., 2025 ) . During the joint Supervised Fine-Tuning (FT) stage, we train the widened transformer blocks for 7000 iterations with a batch size of 1 and a learning rate of 1e-5. For the Velocity-Aware DPO stage, we freeze the backbone and train LoRA adapters (rank r = 64 r=64 ) for 500 iterations using a preference margin threshold δ = 0.05 \delta=0.05 and temperature β = 500 \beta=500 . Training was conducted on 8 NVIDIA H100 GPUs. The codebase is built on DiffSynth ( ModelScope Community, 2024 ) and Epipolar-DPO ( Kupyn et al., 2025 ) .

paragraphs.en: Baselines. We compare our approach against strong foundational video generation models and recent physics-aware methods: 1) Wan-14B ( Wan et al., 2025 ) : The state-of-the-art base model our architecture is built upon, serving as the direct baseline for our physical augmentations. This model also stands for the current performance of the latest open-source video model can achieve on fluid dynamics. 2) FluidNexus ( Gao et al., 2025 ) : On benchmarks with ground-truth data, we also compare with an upgraded multi-view version of the original FluidNexus model. We directly use applicable multi-view videos to reconstruct the underlying fluid representations. And show that even with the additional multi-view information, the pure physics-based approach still can’t faithfully generate complex fluid dynamics at the desired level.
paragraphs.zh: 基线方法。 我们将我们的方法与强大的基础视频生成模型以及近期的物理感知方法进行比较：1) Wan-14B（Wan 等，2025）：作为我们架构所构建的最新（state-of-the-art）基础模型，是我们的物理增强的直接基线。 该模型也代表了最新开源视频模型在流体动力学上所能达到的当前性能。2) FluidNexus（Gao 等，2025）：在具有真值（ground-truth）数据的基准上，我们还与原始 FluidNexus 模型的升级多视角版本进行比较。 我们直接使用适用的多视角视频来重建底层的流体表示。 并表明即使有额外的多视角信息，纯基于物理的方法仍然无法在期望的层面上忠实地生成复杂的流体动力学。

The FluidNexus benchmark ( Gao et al., 2025 ) provides multiview captures of real fluids with ground-truth reference frames; on 15 15 randomly selected sequences, we report PSNR and SSIM for per-frame reconstruction fidelity, LPIPS ( Zhang et al., 2018 ) for perceptual similarity, and FVD ( Unterthiner et al., 2019 ) for distributional distance over spatiotemporal features. To evaluate general video quality on in-the-wild image inputs, we additionally report VBench ( Huang et al., 2024 ) scores on 20 20 selected images along three dimensions relevant to fluid synthesis: Imaging Quality (per-frame visual fidelity), Aesthetic Quality (perceptual appeal), and Subject Consistency (temporal stability of foreground content, critical for coherent advection without flickering).

paragraphs.en: Tab. 2 reports results on the FluidNexus benchmark. We note that the FluidNexus baseline used here is an upgraded multi-view variant of the original method, which consumes multiple synchronized views as input and requires several hours of per-scene optimization to reconstruct the underlying fluid representation. Despite this substantially heavier setup, it still fails to recover some fine level turbulent details such as small scale eddies and high-frequency boundary roll-ups, which is reflected in its lower SSIM and notably higher LPIPS and FVD compared to our method. Wan2.1-I2V-14B, on the other hand, struggles to produce faithful fluid dynamics from a single image and frequently introduces appearance artifacts such as color shifting and texture drift over time. In contrast, our model, conditioned on only a single image and run in a single forward pass, achieves the best or on par metrics with the multi-view FluidNexus baseline, indicating that our generated complex fluid dynamics closely match the ground-truth captures.

paragraphs.en: To verify that our training stages do not compromise general generative capability on in-the-wild content, we evaluate our method using VBench metrics in Tab. 2 . Our final model matches or surpasses the Wan2.1-I2V-14B base model on all three reported dimensions, with clear gains in Imaging Quality and Subject Consistency. paragraphs.en: Fig. 6 shows visual comparisons against ground-truth captures from the FluidNexus benchmark. The upgraded FluidNexus baseline recovers the coarse shape and trajectory of the smoke plume, but its reconstructions after several hours of optimization still appear overly smooth and lose some fine-scale wisps and turbulent filaments visible in the ground truth, indicating the disadvantage of relying only on the manually defined physical approximation laws. Wan2.1-I2V-14B produces motion that diverges from the reference dynamics and exhibits noticeable color drift and appearance inconsistency over time. In contrast, our method reproduces both the global rising trajectory and fine turbulent structures, including thin tendrils at the plume boundary, while requiring only a single forward pass from a single input image. We further compare against Wan2.1-I2V-14B on in-the-wild inputs in Fig. 5 , where our full model produces more vivid and physically realistic fluid dynamics. Finally, our model supports several downstream applications, including fluid-related visual effects (Fig. 1 ) via keyframe control (images are generated by NanoBanana 2 ( Google DeepMind, 2026 ) ), velocity field prediction (Fig. 7 ) from input videos using RePaint-style ( Lugmayr et al., 2022 ) conditional sampling, and fluid simulation driven by the generated 3D velocity fields (Fig. 8 ). More results are provided in Appendix A and on our project page.

The stage I fine-tuning achieves significant gain compared to the basemodel: FluidGen w/o DPO improves PSNR from 22.50 22.50 to 31.52 31.52 and reduces FVD from 569.7 569.7 to 192.1 192.1 over the base model, while improving Subject Consistency on VBench ( 0.8929 → 0.9383 0.8929\rightarrow 0.9383 ). paragraphs.en: We present FluidGen, a framework for synthesizing physically plausible fluid dynamics directly within a video diffusion model, bridging the gap between the rich appearance priors of generative models and the dynamic constraints of classical fluid solvers. By augmenting a pretrained video diffusion transformer with a dual-head architecture, our model jointly predicts RGB pixels and an underlying 3D velocity field, capturing complex fluid dynamics without authored 3D scenes or explicit simulators at inference.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 FluidGen，一个直接在视频扩散模型中合成物理上合理流体动力学的框架，弥合了生成模型丰富的外观先验与经典流体求解器动态约束之间的差距。 通过为预训练的视频扩散 Transformer 增加双头架构，我们的模型联合预测 RGB 像素和底层三维速度场，无需在推理时构建三维场景或使用显式模拟器即可捕捉复杂的流体动力学。

sents.en: We present FluidGen, a framework for synthesizing physically plausible fluid dynamics directly within a video diffusion model, bridging the gap between the rich appearance priors of generative models and the dynamic constraints of classical fluid solvers.
sents.zh: 我们提出 FluidGen，一个直接在视频扩散模型中合成物理上合理流体动力学的框架，弥合了生成模型丰富的外观先验与经典流体求解器动态约束之间的差距。

sents.en: By augmenting a pretrained video diffusion transformer with a dual-head architecture, our model jointly predicts RGB pixels and an underlying 3D velocity field, capturing complex fluid dynamics without authored 3D scenes or explicit simulators at inference.
sents.zh: 通过为预训练的视频扩散 Transformer 增加双头架构，我们的模型联合预测 RGB 像素和底层三维速度场，无需在推理时构建三维场景或使用显式模拟器即可捕捉复杂的流体动力学。

paragraphs.en: Our two-stage training pipeline first jointly fine-tunes the model with dense physical supervision from high-fidelity Houdini simulations alongside the visual diversity of in-the-wild videos, then applies a velocity-aware preference optimization stage that uses the model’s native velocity predictions to compute a physics-informed reward over structural, statistical, and fluid properties, aligning the generator toward turbulent, coherent, and physically sound motion.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的两阶段训练流程首先利用高保真 Houdini 仿真提供的稠密物理监督，结合野外真实视频的视觉多样性，对模型进行联合微调；随后应用一个速度感知的偏好优化阶段，该阶段使用模型原生的速度预测来计算基于结构、统计和流体属性的物理信息奖励，从而使生成器向湍流、连贯且物理合理的运动方向对齐。

paragraphs.en: While our method focuses on volumetric fluids such as smoke, fire, and explosions, the core idea of embedding interpretable physical representations into generative latents points toward a broader paradigm for physics-aware synthesis. Future work could extend the dual-head approach to other physical systems such as liquids or elastic materials, or expose the predicted velocity fields as a direct control handle for artists. Our results demonstrate that with the right internal representations and alignment strategies, large-scale video models can natively master complex physical dynamics.

paragraphs.en: Structural terms target the spatial and temporal organization of the direction field:
paragraphs.zh: 结构术语针对方向场的空间和时间组织：

paragraphs.en: R div R_{\mathrm{div}} penalizes direction collapse via the per-component variance of 𝐮 ^ \hat{\mathbf{u}} ,
paragraphs.zh: R_{\mathrm{div}} 通过 𝐮 ^ \hat{\mathbf{u}} 的各分量方差来惩罚方向坍缩，

paragraphs.en: R tc R_{\mathrm{tc}} measures the temporal Pearson correlation of the spatial gradients of 𝐮 ^ \hat{\mathbf{u}} ,
paragraphs.zh: R tc R_{\mathrm{tc}} 度量 𝐮 ^ \hat{\mathbf{u}} 的空间梯度的时间皮尔逊相关性，

paragraphs.en: R msd R_{\mathrm{msd}} rewards consistent gradient richness at scales s ∈ { 1 , 2 , 4 } s\in\{1,2,4\} so that the flow shows structured detail at all scales rather than blur or pure noise.
paragraphs.zh: R msd R_{\mathrm{msd}} 在尺度 s ∈ { 1 , 2 , 4 } s\in\{1,2,4\} 上提供一致且丰富的梯度，使流在所有尺度上都能呈现结构化细节，而非模糊或纯噪声。

paragraphs.en: Statistical terms match the empirical distribution of Houdini simulations:

paragraphs.zh: R act R_{\mathrm{act}} 对平均活跃像素比例 f ¯ a = 𝔼 t ​ [ | 𝒜 t | / H ​ W ] \bar{f}_{a}=\mathbb{E}_{t}[|\mathcal{A}_{t}|/HW] 的作用，

paragraphs.en: R tdb R_{\mathrm{tdb}} on the mean temporal change of R t R_{t} ,
paragraphs.zh: R tdb R_{\mathrm{tdb}} 对 R t R_{t} 的平均时间变化的（影响），

paragraphs.en: R lc R_{\mathrm{lc}} on the global rise-peak-decay envelope of per-frame energy e t = 𝔼 x , y ​ [ ρ t ] e_{t}=\mathbb{E}_{x,y}[\rho_{t}] via a weighted combination of peak position, monotone rise, monotone decay, second-derivative smoothness, and contrast sub-scores { s k } \{s_{k}\} ,
paragraphs.zh: R lc R_{\mathrm{lc}} 位于逐帧能量 e t = 𝔼 x , y ​ [ ρ t ] e_{t}=\mathbb{E}_{x,y}[\rho_{t}] 的全局“上升-峰值-衰减”包络上，通过对峰值位置、单调上升、单调衰减、二阶导数平滑度以及对比度子分数 { s k } \{s_{k}\} 的加权组合进行计算，

paragraphs.en: R adv R_{\mathrm{adv}} checks one-step advection self-consistency through a bilinear warp 𝒲 \mathcal{W} of 𝐯 t \mathbf{v}_{t} along ( v x , v z ) (v_{x},v_{z}) ,

paragraphs.en: R Q R_{Q} rewards a spread of the Q-criterion of 𝐮 ^ \hat{\mathbf{u}} , Q u ^ = Ω 12 2 − ( S 11 2 + S 22 2 + 2 ​ S 12 2 ) Q_{\hat{u}}=\Omega_{12}^{2}-(S_{11}^{2}+S_{22}^{2}+2S_{12}^{2}) , where S S and Ω \Omega are the symmetric and antisymmetric parts of ∇ 𝐮 ^ \nabla\hat{\mathbf{u}} ( Hunt et al., 1988 ) ,

paragraphs.en: We synthesize the training set in SideFX Houdini using its Pyro solver, covering three asset families: rising fire , ambient smoke , and bursting explosions . paragraphs.en: Source emitter. For fire and smoke we instantiate a noisy spherical emitter whose center is sampled from a Gaussian around the world origin. The noise displacement amplitude, pulse duration, fractal octaves and roughness are re-sampled per scene to diversify the initial density and temperature fields. Explosions reuse an authored .hipnc scene built around SideFX’s pyro burst source and the Axiom GPU solver, with the shapeoffset seed randomized so each run starts from a different turbulent pattern.

paragraphs.en: Rendering and velocity AOV. We render with Karma renderer at 128 128 path-traced samples. To export per-pixel velocity, we patch the Pyro shader’s material network with two binded VOPs: the first reads the volume’s vel attribute, the second exports it under the AOV name velocity . This produces a second image in the same EXR whose three channels are the velocity at that pixel.
paragraphs.zh: 渲染与速度 AOV。 我们使用 Karma 渲染器进行渲染，路径追踪采样数为 128 128。 为了导出逐像素速度，我们在 Pyro 着色器的材质网络中打补丁加入两个绑定的 VOP：第一个读取体积的 vel 属性，第二个以 AOV 名称 velocity 导出它。 这会在同一个 EXR 中生成第二张图像，其三个通道是该像素处的速度。
